description: The golden grid from goldenratio.app/#/grid: w-grp-1..11, w-grp-half-*, w-grp-double-* percentage widths, the starter .container/.row CSS, every example row from the site with its total width, and an optional check of your own row (does it add up to exactly 100%?).

container_px.description: Also give each width in px for a row this wide.

include_examples.description: Include the site example rows (default true).

row.description: Widths to check as one row, e.g. ["5", "4"] or ["half-4", "5", "half-4"] (w-grp- prefix optional).

name: golden_grid
title: Golden grid
